title: Perform scientific calculations
description: Switch Calculator to Scientific mode, compute 2^10, and copy the result to the clipboard.
natural_language_instruction: Open the Windows Calculator app, switch the mode to Scientific, compute 2 raised to the power of 10 (2^10), and copy the result to the clipboard using Ctrl+C.

metadata.author: benchmark_team
metadata.notes: Tests Scientific mode toggling and exponentiation.
